name: Qingyuan Circuit
alt: Quanzhou and Zhangzhou under Liu Congxiao

predecessors.name: Min
predecessors.text: Quan and Zhang prefectures, the southern coast of the former Min; Liu Congxiao killed the Min prefect Huang Shaopo of Quan in winter 944

successors.name: Song dynasty (Northern and Southern Song)
successors.text: 'Chen went to Kaifeng and surrendered Pinghai Circuit, consisting of Quan and Zhang prefectures, to Emperor Taizong'

rulers.name: Liu Congxiao
rulers.title: prefect of Quan from 946; Qingyuan jiedushi from 949

ledger.x: 978: Chen Hongjin surrenders Quan and Zhang.

wars.name: Southern Tang pressure on Quan
wars.outcome: The Southern Tang left Quan in spring 947 after Liu Congxiao pressed its detachment; no border changed.

certainty.note: Two prefectures with no frontier line on either page.
